title: Payoff and Loan Satisfaction Worksheet: Seller Closing Contribution
content:
# Seller closing contribution worksheet — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

On the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record, the seller closing contribution is the contribution shortfall plus the contribution cushion plus three contribution charges (the contribution wire fee, the contribution returned-item fee and the contribution title search fee), rounded half up to the cent and only at that last step; the shortfall is floored at 0.00 before the cushion and the charges are added.

**Contribution shortfall.** The contract costs above the allowance: the commission amount plus the other closing costs of the case's accepted purchase contract submission, the latest by request date (where several accepted submissions share that request date, the largest commission amount and the largest other closing costs among them), less the allowed closing costs the payoff case carries, less the funds the case holds net of returns (every payoff funds receipt on the case less every payoff funds return on it), and never below 0.00. A case with no accepted purchase contract submission counts its contract costs as 0.00.

**Cushion and charges.** The contribution cushion, the contribution wire fee and the contribution returned-item fee are each 0.00, and the contribution title search fee is USD 40.00.

| Line | Item | Hypothetical figure |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Commission on the accepted contract | USD 26000.00 |
| 2 | Other closing costs on the accepted contract | USD 9000.00 |
| 3 | Allowed closing costs on the case | USD 33000.00 |
| 4 | Net funds already held | 0.00 |
| 5 | Contribution shortfall (lines 1 and 2, less lines 3 and 4, not below 0.00) | USD 2000.00 |
| 6 | Cushion, wire fee, returned-item fee | 0.00 |
| 7 | Title search fee | USD 40.00 |
| 8 | Seller closing contribution | USD 2040.00 |

Had the case already held USD 2500.00 net, line 5 would be 0.00 and the contribution USD 40.00. The figures are invented for the illustration.
